slices.focus: Clinic visit forces Jae-hyun to confront shift work's health toll.
slices.summary: After two brutal humid night shifts, Jae-hyun's reflux forces a clinic visit near Nampo. The doctor prescribes strict meal timing, less fried food, and basic treatment, also flagging chronic neck tension from the radio desk. Jae-hyun adopts three defaults: no fried dock meals as first option, packed food before night shifts, and a neck-break routine during natural lulls.
open_loops: Consistency of meal-prep habit during busy weeks
Balancing health needs with rotating shift demands
